name: GPU decoder plan
input: User asks for a GPU-accelerated LDPC decoder rewrite with vague speed goals.
expected_behavior: Creates slices for oracle, baseline, kernel seams, memory layout, benchmark gates, and correctness evidence before implementation.

name: Quantum runtime refactor
input: User asks to refactor a circuit runtime across transpiler, scheduler, and backend target layers.
expected_behavior: Slices by ownership seams and verification gates rather than producing a monolithic refactor plan.

name: Small bug
input: User asks for a one-line typo or doc fix.
expected_behavior: Does not force a spec folder; explains that a simple direct change is enough.

name: Multi-slice implementation
input: A spec has five slices, two independent and one red gate.
expected_behavior: Chooses independent work safely, verifies each pass, updates handoff, and does not stop after the first green slice.

name: QEC slice discovers bad assumption
input: During implementation the detector semantics differ from the plan.
expected_behavior: Stops broadening the patch, updates and reslices the spec, records the deviation, and verifies with QEC evidence.

name: Scratch leak
input: After a GPU pass, debug scripts and profiling dumps remain in the tree.
expected_behavior: Identifies task-created scratch artifacts, preserves user files, retains useful evidence, and keeps the commit focused.

name: Closed GPU spec
input: A GPU optimization spec has shipped with benchmark evidence.
expected_behavior: Rewrites build steps into rationale, preserves profiler and benchmark provenance, and points to code and tests.

name: QEC experiment spec
input: A QEC decoder experiment changed assumptions during implementation.
expected_behavior: Records final assumptions, logical observables, detector semantics, evidence, and dropped alternatives.

name: Unfinished spec
input: Some slices remain red or unverified.
expected_behavior: Refuses to close as done and identifies the remaining gates or decisions.

name: selection-near-miss-exact-heading
prompt: Replace this heading with the exact supplied text.
checks: does not select this skill for this task merely because of a related keyword
does not add unrelated artifacts, approval gates, or work

checks: does not select this skill for this task merely because of a related keyword

name: section-boundary-review-only
prompt: Review a spec for omissions; do not implement it.
checks: reviews the spec for omissions without starting implementation
does not add unrelated artifacts, approval gates, or work

name: section-boundary-open-slices
prompt: Implement the first of five still-open slices.
checks: implements the named slice and does not run the closing section while slices remain open
does not add unrelated artifacts, approval gates, or work
